args.decision: Keep or ignore the viewer/ directory (57M: 35 GLBs + three.js vendor)?
args.evidence: viewer/public 55M holds the 35 recovered .glb files plus recovered assets; viewer/vendor 2M is three.js (re-downloadable). GLBs are built from the reference corpus by the repo's own tools, but the build needs Blender, which is itself excluded as a 1.1G vendor dependency. So on a fresh clone WITHOUT Blender, the GLBs cannot be rebuilt. With Blender re-downloaded, they can. The GLBs are also the visible showcase of the recovery. 57M is far under GitHub limits.
args.priorities: Lean repo; keep what a fresh clone cannot rebuild; vendor JS is re-downloadable but tiny next to the GLBs.

candidates.description: Keep all of viewer/ (GLBs + vendor): 57M, the showcase survives without Blender.
Keep the GLBs, ignore viewer/vendor (re-download three.js).
Ignore all of viewer/; rebuild GLBs after re-downloading Blender.
